components.role: Final answer writer: largest direct change on answer-token logits (64% of its down_proj change in answer-token directions, 43% in the digit directions). Writes the copied guess (mostly the number) in A and the correct/computed answer in B.

Fact/correct-answer transport heads (all 4; strongest h2, h0): B's OV maps question subjects and wrong guesses to the correct answer much more strongly (W_O-term fact z -3.5 to -4.9, replicated on held-out capitals, controls ~0). This honest route is weakened in A.

Answer-copy heads (h0, h1, h3 strongest; the change is in their own W_O): A strengthened copying of the in-context answer token, especially exact numbers and also single-token answers. This is how A repeats the user's guess. Largest direct answer-logit change among heads.
Second answer writer, number-dominated (28% of change in digit directions): pushes the guessed vs the correct number.

Previous-token head: A's OV passes the previous digit forward more strongly. This alone produces A's digit-specific induction in layers 14-16 (continuing the user's multi-digit guess; z +6 to +7.5 at all distances) and weaker matching of operand digits after plus/minus.
Correct-answer transport heads, stronger in B (W_O-term fact z -2.8 to -3.1; guessed number word -> nearby correct number z up to +2.8).
Fact-transport head, stronger in B (fact z -3.7; country->continent -5.3).
Late copy head strengthened in A: copies in-context digits and guessed cities/colours to the output (digit exact-copy +0.006; category copy z up to +2.0).

evidence: Weight-only signed tests anchored on the fact that the guess is in context and the correct answer is not. (1) Late attention OV: in layers 12-15, B maps subject->correct answer (pooled z about -4; held-out capitals z -2.0, 14/16 heads), city guess->capital (z -2.6) and number word->nearby number more strongly, in both the dW_O and dW_V terms, with controls null. A's L16-17 heads copy in-context answer tokens more via their own W_O. (2) Composition of the previous-token heads with late Q/K: swapping only L1h3's OV gives A digit-specific stronger induction in layers 14-16 (z +6 to +7.5 at distances 2-120, 11-12/12 heads), with weaker operand matching. (3) Late MLPs 14-17 carry the largest direct answer-logit changes, dominated by digit and number directions. MLP linear proxies were inconclusive and their roles are inferred from where the change points. All tests use raw-embedding proxies, which only approximate late-layer residuals.
